title: Jazzy Yeasty Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A yeasty, crispy, romantic Saudi-Arabian dish featuring harissa spice, dehydrated to perfection, served in a cataplana vessel, shojin-friendly for a unique dining experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together harissa spice, yeast, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the vessel and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the vessel and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces to the vessel and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the dehydrated apricots, prunes, and cataplana broth to the vessel.
Cover the vessel and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
